_comment: Common / historical / colloquial place names → province IDs or ISO2 country codes. Keys are matched case-insensitively (whitespace/punctuation tolerant). Values are either a single ID/code string OR a list of them. Province IDs look like 'CN-65'. Country codes are 2-letter ISO2 ('IR', 'CN'). The LLM tool lookup_province handles both — country codes resolve to a country meta-record so the model can follow up with provinces_in_country.
